rows: Decision: port both for the five tools whose credential is a file or a command (claude, codex, opencode, gemini, gcloud), with their login commands and validity checks as data in `auth.rs` (claude and the file tools: the `validCheck` path, else all `credentialPaths`; gcloud: its `gcloud auth list | grep .` probe). `login` runs the tool's command through `sh -c` with inherited stdio, reports a non-zero exit as `login command exited N`, then checks the credential. `remote-login` starts a session on the listener (`POST /auth/start {tool}`), prints the link, polls the same check every `VNC_AUTH_POLL_INTERVAL_MS` (2 s) up to `VNC_AUTH_CAPTURE_TIMEOUT_MS` (5 min), then makes the best-effort `/auth/done`; an unknown tool fails before any secret or network access. `leetcode` (its credential lives in the browser and is verified against a backend) falls through to the TS. With this the `wf auth` group is native except leetcode.
